name: storage-emergency-selfheal
title: 存储熔断自愈与快照容量淘汰
description: 修复存储熔断后清理不唤醒、空间判定口径死区，让普通快照参与容量淘汰并联动出清DB悬空记录，补齐锁定证据预算与清理可观测性
creator: nikoniko
notes: Board evidence: free 2040.7MiB < 2048MiB tripped emergency while used/total 88.7% < high 90; tick() only prunes on warning; snapshots only TTL-pruned so a snapshot-only volume never frees space. Decisions after review: usagePercent = used/(used+free) with non-root caveat (root Bfree==Bavail degenerates); emergency stop = free>=1.25*minFree AND usage<high, checked before the first delete; Phase 1 all-expired sweep is exempt from the capacity stop, Phase 2 pre-checks; manual only evicts unexpired media when Phase 2 stop is not yet met; TTL is a ceiling, not a must-delete-at-deadline; R3+R5+R8 must ship together; DB cascade uses a new pending_snapshot_deletes migration for retry/restart durability; R9 backfills locks for historical alarm images and adds an evidence guard; locked evidence never auto-deleted; front-end capacity bar must use used+free as denominator.
